key_insight: Among the three D-gun spray distances tested, 190 mm produced the lowest-porosity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating and best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance can improve coating integrity and help protect DSS 2205 components exposed to acidic environments.
method: Deposit Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings at spray distances of 170, 180 and 190 mm.
Examine coating morphology and porosity using SEM.
Evaluate corrosion in 1 M H₂SO₄ at room temperature using OCP, impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarization.
evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm; the 190 mm coating achieved a corrosion rate of 0.113 mm/year versus 2.60 mm/year for uncoated DSS 2205.
watch_item: The 190 mm optimum applies to the tested conditions; durability under other acids, temperatures and long-term industrial exposure remains unestablished.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
